# KILIMO Agritech - LLM Access Guide

## Overview
KILIMO Agritech is a platform dedicated to advancing agriculture through technology, education, and quality seeds.

## Core Purpose
KILIMO Agritech aims to:
1. Provide quality agricultural education through e-learning courses
2. Offer high-yield, certified seeds to farmers
3. Supply essential agricultural products and equipment
4. Share knowledge and best practices for sustainable farming
5. Support agricultural innovation and technology adoption

## Brand Identity
- Name: KILIMO Agritech
- Mission: Revolutionize agriculture through technology and education for African farmers
- Colors: Green (primary), representing growth and agriculture
- Logo: https://akouma-agritech.lovable.app/kilimo-logo.png

## Key Features
- E-learning platform with course enrollments and certifications
- E-commerce for seeds and agricultural products
- News and blog section for agricultural insights
- Partnership program for collaboration
- Career opportunities in agritech
- Contact and support system
- Admin dashboard for managing content and users
